title: Total site of a coherent pseudofunctor of sites
statement: Let $I$ be a small category and let $(\mathcal C_i)_{i\in I}$ be sites [def-weil-size-convention] [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For every arrow $\alpha:i\to j$ suppose we have a continuous functor $u_\alpha:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$, together with unit isomorphisms $u_{\mathrm{id}_i}\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C_i}$ and compositor isomorphisms $u_\alpha u_\beta\cong u_{\beta\alpha}$ for composable $i\xrightarrow{\alpha}j\xrightarrow{\beta}k$, satisfying the unit and pentagon coherence laws. Assume that each $u_\alpha$ preserves the fibre products used to pull back covering families. The Grothendieck total category has objects $(i,U)$ with $U\in\mathcal C_i$ and arrows $(\alpha,f):(i,U)\to(j,V)$ for $\alpha:i\to j$, $U\in\mathcal C_i$, $V\in\mathcal C_j$, and $f:U\to u_\alpha(V)$ in $\mathcal C_i$; composition uses the compositor isomorphisms $u_\alpha u_\beta\cong u_{\beta\alpha}$ and is associative. The covering topology is generated by the vertical families $(\mathrm{id}_i,f_\ell):(i,U_\ell)\to(i,U)$ whose $f_\ell$ form a covering family in $\mathcal C_i$ (equivalently, a sieve is covering when it contains such a generating family). Pulling a generating cover back along any $(\alpha,f)$ is computed after applying $u_\alpha$ and forming the indicated pullback, and is again a covering, so this generated topology is a site and every isomorphism sieve is covering.
